name: Sprout
author: Paolo Pino
tagline: A Pocket Scion companion for the FM-1, derived from AMB-1
description: Sprout is a Pocket Scion companion for the M-VAVE FM-1, derived from AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Eight scenes (a cherry garden, mycelium, a growing Monstera, the Earth, a seagrass meadow, a river at night, a lighthouse in a storm and a beach at sunset) answer the notes and CCs that the Instruo Pocket Scion sends over MIDI: every channel rings its own bell, a CC map steers the voices, the effects and a granulator, and a quiet generative bed plays underneath.
credits: Derived from AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
